from collections import Counter

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/sample_variant.xlsx', read_only=True)

# Collect all SO terms and Effects
so_terms = Counter()
effects = Counter()
vafs = []
gene_names = Counter()
zygosities = Counter()

for row in range(3, 1000):  # data starts at row 3
    so = ws.cell(row, 14).value
    effect = ws.cell(row, 15).value
    vaf = ws.cell(row, 10).value
    gene = ws.cell(row, 13).value
    zyg = ws.cell(row, 5).value
    
    if so is None:
        break
    so_terms[str(so)] += 1
    effects[str(effect)] += 1
    if gene:
        gene_names[str(gene)] += 1
    if zyg:
        zygosities[str(zyg)] += 1
    if vaf is not None:
        try:
            vafs.append(float(vaf))
        except:
            pass

print("=== SO Terms ===")
for term, count in so_terms.most_common(30):
    print(f"  {term}: {count}")

print(f"\n=== Effects ===")
for term, count in effects.most_common():
    print(f"  {term}: {count}")

print(f"\n=== VAF stats ===")
print(f"  Count: {len(vafs)}")
print(f"  Min: {min(vafs) if vafs else 'N/A'}")
print(f"  Max: {max(vafs) if vafs else 'N/A'}")
print(f"  < 0.3: {sum(1 for v in vafs if v < 0.3)}")
print(f"  >= 0.3: {sum(1 for v in vafs if v >= 0.3)}")

print(f"\n=== Zygosities ===")
for term, count in zygosities.most_common():
    print(f"  {term}: {count}")

print(f"\n=== Sample unique genes ===")
print(f"  Total unique genes: {len(gene_names)}")
